supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

canonicalRoot(bytes32).notice: Compute the canonical SHA-256 domain-separated commitment to the         verifier entries under a given registry root.

canonicalRootMatches(bytes32).notice: Check whether the committed registry root matches the actual         canonical root computed from entries.

computeCanonicalRoot(bytes32[],address[].notice: Compute the canonical registry root from entry data without         requiring entries to be stored. Used by governance to determine         the correct registryRoot before registering verifiers.
